newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tonen to start new residue cracker this week.
newsitem.headline: Tonen to start new residue cracker this week.

text.p: Tonen Corp said on Tuesday it plans to start operation of a 25,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) residue cracker at its 240,000-bpd Kawasaki plant near Tokyo this week.
"It will be Japan's first cracker capable of processing residue oil produced at vacuum distillation units into middle distillates," a Tonen spokesman said.
The unit has a capacity to produce about 16,700 bpd of middle distillates, he said.
The unit is expected to enable the refiner to shift its crude oil purchases from light crudes to heavier material, he said. Heavy crudes are usually cheaper than light grades.
